# the same numbers as _IOWR macros for syz-extract to consume on the SUT.


# Parameter structs for every description in this set. Padding is
# explicit and every struct is packed, so the emitted size is the
# measured size and does not depend on syzkaller's alignment rules
# agreeing with the compiler's.
